why: A full-tier batch dispatches one reviewer subagent per PR/MR without asking; a cross-MR or parallel dispatch still asks. Light tier stays in the main session.
command: /git-issue-pr https://github.com/acme/widget/issues/21 (batch submit of issues 21 and 22; you are at the pre-submit gate for both; commits are made and tests pass)
extra:
Both submits are full tier. PR 21 range is merge-base aaa..bbb (8 files, 220 lines). PR 22 range is merge-base ccc..ddd (6 files, 90 lines). Before any reviewer dispatch, print exactly these lines:
Ask before per-MR reviewer: yes|no
Ask before cross-MR reviewer: yes|no
Ask before parallel reviewers: yes|no
Light-tier subagent: yes|no
A per-MR reviewer is one fresh subagent for one PR/MR under the dispatch contract. Cross-MR means one subagent reviews both ranges. Parallel means several reviewer subagents at once. Light-tier subagent is whether a 2-file, 20-line range would dispatch a subagent.
